nicknames: The Mecca of North American Harness Racing
Home of the North America Cup

main_track.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise. The premier 7/8-mile harness oval in North America featuring wide, sweeping turns and a grueling 1,095-foot home stretch. ABSOLUTELY NO PASSING LANE exists. Pocket-sitters (2nd along the rail) risk getting hopelessly locked in if the pacesetter tires. Second-over (cover-following) and first-over outer-flow trips are heavily favored on firm, fast nights.
main_track.post_bias: POWER ALLEY (Posts 4, 5 & 6): Posts 4–6 account for over 45% of total wins. Post 6 sits at the ideal speed-acceleration angle off the mobile gate wing. POST 1 SHUFFLE RISK: Post 1 carries a significant penalty for horses lacking top 1st-call gate speed due to the absence of an inside sprint lane. POSTS 9 & 10: Require aggressive early usage or outer cover to overcome wide first-turn entry.

handicapping_angles.no_passing_lane_pocket_trap: Because Mohawk lacks an inside sprint/passing lane, aggressively penalize non-speed horses drawn inside (Posts 1–2) who are likely to get shuffled back behind a weak pacesetter. Strongly upgrade 1st-over and 2nd-over outer-flow stalkers with clear stretch running room.
handicapping_angles.half_mile_bullring_shipper_tax: Deduct -4.0 points from horses shipping in from 1/2-mile bullrings (Flamboro Downs, Grand River, Western Fair, London). Half-mile specialists accustomed to short 400-foot home straights frequently exhaust themselves trying to sustain momentum down Mohawk's massive 1,095-foot stretch.
handicapping_angles.sub_27_final_quarter_requirement: To win in Preferred, FFA, or upper condition ranks (NW5000+ L5), pacers must possess an individual sub-27.0 second final quarter (L1/4) capability off cover. Upgrade horses coming off fast finishing splits on 7/8 or 1-mile ovals.
handicapping_angles.driver_choice_and_elite_pilot_synergy: Driver intent is critical at Mohawk. Upgrade horses when top pilots (James MacDonald, Louis-Philippe Roy, Doug McNair, Sylvain Filion, Bob McClure) select one entry over another in the official program driver choices.
handicapping_angles.trot_vs_pace_gait_stability: In trotting events (Maple Leaf Trot, Goodtimes lines), horses with any recent break in stride ('b.t.') must be penalized by -3.0 points unless demonstrating a flawless flat qualifier line at Mohawk.
